 /* size carefully selected to trigger an overflow */","note":"The destination buffer size is fixed to 4116 bytes, which the test author explicitly marked as the size that triggers the overflow condition."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lz4/tests/fuzzer.c","function":"main","line":1224,"var":"result","code":"result = LZ4_compress_HC_destSize(&sHC, (const char*)block, (char*)dstBlock, &srcSize, (int)targetSize, 3);","note":"Attacker-controlled input data is passed into the LZ4 high-compression destination-sized compressor, which propagates the crafted long run into the vulnerable compression routine."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lz4/lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_HC_destSize","line":null,"var":"LZ4_compress_generic(...)","code":"The destination-sized HC compressor delegates to the generic compression engine with the caller-provided output limit.","note":"This is the propagation step where the compressor computes match and literal encoding while assuming the output limit is sufficient."},{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lz4/lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic","line":1030,"var":"op","code":"LZ4_write32(op, 0xFFFFFFFF);","note":"When encoding a long match, the compressor writes 4 bytes at the current output pointer; with the crafted 4116-byte destination this write can run past the end of the heap buffer."},{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/lz4/lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_write32","line":237,"var":"*(U32*)memPtr","code":"static void LZ4_write32(void* memPtr, U32 value) { *(U32*)memPtr = value; }","note":"The sink is the raw 32-bit store into the destination buffer, which becomes a heap-buffer-overflow write when the output pointer has advanced beyond the allocated region."}]
